plain_text:
Benita Hume appears in 57 recordings across 3 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1937 to 1953. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Benita Hume most often in The Halls of Ivy, Lux Radio Theatre, and Screen Directors Playhouse.

Characters credited here include Victoria Hall.
